annotations.text: Direction A (built out): the game picks each nation's best-ranked riders. You do not run the national team; your riders bring the glory home. Three screens: Overview, Nations, Results. Same T3 race-page anatomy as every other race.

Open, one at a time:
1. Road race only, or also a time trial?
2. Does club racing pause on Worlds day?
3. Prize money for the club of a medallist?
Rainbow jersey = prestige and reputation only, never a strength boost.
Direction B (sketch beside, not instead): the best-ranked manager of a nation coaches it for one season. More agency, but most nations would be auto-picked anyway. Can be layered on A later.
